repositories.tile.title: Repositories
repositories.tile.description: Hosted, proxy and group repositories of every format
repositories.list.title: Repositories
repositories.list.description: Where components are stored, cached from remote repositories or combined under one address.
repositories.list.label: Repositories
repositories.list.search: Find by name, URL or blob store
repositories.list.name: Name
repositories.list.emptyText: Create one to publish components, or to cache those of a remote repository.
repositories.types.hosted: Stores the components you publish to it.
repositories.types.proxy: Caches the components of a remote repository when they are first asked for.
repositories.types.group: Serves several repositories of the format under one address.
repositories.create.title: Create a repository
repositories.create.description: Choose the format and how the repository gets its components.
repositories.create.noneText: Your account may not create repositories of any format this server offers.
repositories.create.unknown: This kind of repository cannot be created here
repositories.create.unknownText: The server offers no {format} {type} repositories, or your account may not create them.
repositories.form.sections.storageText: Where the repository keeps its files and what it accepts.
repositories.form.sections.proxyText: The remote repository and how long its answers are cached.
repositories.form.sections.negativeCache: Remembers paths the remote does not have, so they are not asked for again on every request.
repositories.form.sections.httpClientTex: How the server connects to the remote repository.
repositories.form.sections.authenticatio: Credentials the server sends to the remote repository.
repositories.form.sections.groupText: The repositories this group serves, asked in this order.
repositories.form.sections.dockerText: How Docker and OCI clients reach the repository.
repositories.form.name: Name
repositories.form.nameHint: Letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.'. It cannot be changed later.
repositories.form.blobStoreHint: Where the files of the repository are kept. It cannot be changed later.
repositories.form.blobStoreFixed: The blob store cannot be changed after the repository is created.
repositories.form.strictHint: Refuse files whose content does not match the type their name or request declares.
repositories.form.writePolicyHint: Whether clients may publish, and whether they may replace what is already there.
repositories.form.latestPolicyHint: Clients may push the latest tag again even when redeploying is disabled.
repositories.form.remoteUrlHint: The address of the repository to proxy, for example https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/
repositories.form.contentMaxAgeHint: How long a cached component is served before it is checked against the remote again; -1 means never.
repositories.form.metadataMaxAgeHint: How long cached metadata is served before it is fetched again; -1 means never.
repositories.form.negativeCacheEnabledHi: Paths the remote did not have are answered with 404 from the cache for a while.
repositories.form.blockedHint: The server stops contacting the remote and serves only what is cached.
repositories.form.autoBlock: Block automatically while the remote fails
repositories.form.autoBlockHint: Contact pauses after failures and resumes once the remote answers again.
repositories.form.retriesHint: From 0 to 10; empty uses the server default.
repositories.form.timeoutHint: From 1 to 3600; empty uses the server default.
repositories.form.userAgentSuffixHint: Added to the User-Agent header of requests to the remote.
repositories.form.preemptive: Send credentials with the first request
repositories.form.preemptiveHint: Otherwise they are sent only after the remote asks for them.
repositories.form.membersHint: A request is answered by the first member that has the path. Drag the members or use the arrows to change the order.
repositories.form.noCandidates: There are no other {format} repositories to add.
repositories.form.writableMemberHint: Uploads to the group go to this hosted member.
repositories.form.layoutPolicyHint: Whether every path must follow the Maven repository layout.
repositories.form.contentDispositionHint: Whether browsers show files or download them.
repositories.form.forceBasicAuthHint: Clients must sign in even to pull. Turn it off to let anonymous pulls through when anonymous access is on.
repositories.form.pathEnabledHint: Clients reach the repository at <host>/<repository>/<image> on the main port.
repositories.form.portHint: A port of its own for this repository; empty means none.
repositories.form.subdomainHint: Kept for subdomain routing, which the server does not serve yet.
repositories.form.cacheForeignLayersHint: Layers that images refer to on other hosts are downloaded and served from here.
repositories.form.forwardQueryParameters: The query string of a request is passed on to the remote.
repositories.form.readOnly: You can read these settings but not change them.
repositories.form.hiddenSettings: Cleanup policies, routing rules and settings of other formats are kept as they are.
repositories.form.errors.namePattern: Use letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.'; the name cannot start with '_' or '.'
repositories.form.errors.remoteUrlRequir: Enter the address of the remote repository
repositories.form.errors.urlInvalid: Enter an http:// or https:// address with a host
repositories.form.errors.maxAge: Enter a whole number of minutes, or -1
repositories.form.errors.timeToLive: Enter a whole number of minutes, 0 or more
repositories.form.errors.retries: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10
repositories.form.errors.timeout: Enter a whole number of seconds from 1 to 3600
repositories.form.errors.portsDiffer: Use another port than the HTTP port
repositories.form.errors.indexUrlRequire: Enter the address of the index
repositories.edit.offlineText: Clients get no answers from the repository until it is brought online again. Its settings and content stay.
repositories.edit.onlineText: Clients can reach the repository again.
repositories.edit.saveFirst: Save or discard your changes first
repositories.edit.invalidateText: Cached content is checked against the remote again on its next request, and remembered missing paths are forgotten.
repositories.edit.rebuildText: Search results for the repository are refreshed from its content. For a large repository this takes a while.
repositories.edit.rebuilt: The index of {name} is being rebuilt
repositories.edit.notFound: There is no repository named {name}, or you cannot see it.
repositories.delete.title: Delete {name}?
repositories.delete.hosted: The repository is removed with every component and asset published to it, and their files in the blob store.
repositories.delete.proxy: The repository is removed with everything it cached, and the files in the blob store. The remote repository is not touched.
repositories.delete.group: The group and its address are removed. Its members and their content stay.
repositories.delete.groups: It is also taken out of these groups: {groups}.
repositories.membership.membersText: In the order the group asks them.
repositories.membership.noMembers: The group has no members you can see.
repositories.membership.groupsText: These groups serve the content of this repository under their own address.
repositories.audit.title: Recent events
repositories.audit.label: Recent events of the repository
repositories.audit.empty: No events are recorded for this repository
